name: Invest in Digital Economy Agreement (IDEA)
eligibilitySummary: Ontario provincial program helping small and medium-sized businesses adopt digital technologies to grow and compete. Covers costs for digital transformation projects including e-commerce, digital marketing, CRM, and cybersecurity upgrades.

funding.description: Grants from $2,500 to $15,000 covering up to 50% of eligible costs for digital technology adoption. Can fund e-commerce platforms, digital marketing, CRM systems, cybersecurity tools, and digital training.

application.applicationRequirements: Must be an Ontario-based business with 1-99 employees and $10M or less in annual revenue. Must have a digital adoption plan and purchase digital technologies from an Ontario-based vendor. Business must be registered and operating in Ontario.
